# title: SCOTET: A Tribute to John Scofield
description: Vironas Ntolas (guitar), Kostas Yaxoglou (keyboards), Giorgos Kostopoulos (bass) and Simos Riniotis (drums) play music from across John Scofield's discography, from the melodic and blues sides to the funk and fusion grooves of his Miles Davis years. Tickets via Ticketmaster.

# title: Yiannis Kassetas: Suite For My Daughter
description: Saxophonist and Berklee graduate Yiannis Kassetas presents his new suite, which grew from a lullaby he improvised for his infant daughter, with Dimitris Papadopoulos (trumpet), Kostis Christodoulou (piano), Periklis Trivolis (double bass), Dimitris Klonis (drums) and guest guitarist Vironas Ntolas. Contemporary jazz, post-bop and modal jazz. Tickets via Ticketmaster.

Finnish trumpeter Jykä Ahola, who has played Athens more than thirty times since 2021, joins pianist Stefanos Kozanis, bassist Chrysostomos Boukalis and drummer Nikos Sidirokastritis: originals by Ahola and Kozanis plus pieces by Charlie Haden, Carla Bley, Kurt Weill, Herbie Hancock, David Bowie, Radiohead, Marcus Miller and Hermeto Pascoal, with Greek and Scandinavian melodies and an ECM sensibility. Tickets via Ticketmaster.

Nikos Touliatos, Nikos Sidirokastritis and Simone Mongelli on drums and percussion meet Gilad Atzmon (woodwinds, electronics, double bass) in a one-off night of freely improvised music — a revival of the well-received encounter of three years ago; the sound is created live, without predetermined forms. Tickets via Ticketmaster.
